Get a standup report. It covers today by default, or yesterday, the week, the month, or a from/to range. Done entries come from the period. Open blockers and next items carry forward from before the period. You can filter by project, repo, and tags.

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `yesterday` | `boolean` | no | Cover yesterday and today. |
| `week` | `boolean` | no | Cover the current week. |
| `month` | `boolean` | no | Cover the current month. |
| `from` | `string` | no | Start of the period (inclusive): a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. Overrides yesterday, week, and month. |
| `to` | `string` | no | End of the period (inclusive): a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. Overrides yesterday, week, and month. |
| `project` | `string` | no | Only entries of this project. |
| `repo` | `string` | no | Only entries of this repository (owner/name). |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | Only entries that have all of these tags. |

## Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `title` | `string` | yes |  |
| `start` | `string` | yes |  |
| `end` | `string` | yes |  |
| `isMultiDay` | `boolean` | yes |  |
| `done` | `object[]` | yes |  |
| `done.project` | `string` | yes |  |
| `done.entries` | `object[]` | yes |  |
| `done.entries.id` | `string` | yes | Unique id of the entry. The last 8 characters work as a short id. |
| `done.entries.createdAt` | `string` | yes | When the entry was created, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `done.entries.updatedAt` | `string` | yes | When the entry last changed, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `done.entries.deletedAt` | `string \| null` | yes | When the entry was deleted, or null if it is not deleted. |
| `done.entries.deviceId` | `string` | yes | Id of the device that created the entry. |
| `done.entries.summary` | `string` | yes | One line that says what happened. |
| `done.entries.details` | `string \| null` | yes | Longer text for the entry, or null. |
| `done.entries.kind` | `"done" \| "blocker" \| "next"` | yes | done, blocker (something stops you), or next (a planned step). |
| `done.entries.status` | `"open" \| "resolved" \| null` | yes | open or resolved for a blocker or next entry. Null for a done entry. |
| `done.entries.resolvedAt` | `string \| null` | yes | When the entry was resolved, or null. |
| `done.entries.resolvedByEntryId` | `string \| null` | yes | Id of the entry that resolved this one, or null. |

## Examples

Get today's standup for one project.

```json
{
  "project": "billing-api"
}
```

The text result:

```markdown
## Standup: Today (2026-11-15)

### Done

**billing-api**
- 16:04 Fix rounding error in invoice totals

### Blockers
- `WESHEAS9` Cannot reproduce the failing webhook retry in staging (billing-api, since Nov 15)

### Next
- `TXG3ZWS3` Add a regression test for tax rounding (billing-api, since Nov 15)
```

The structured result holds the same data as JSON. This example shows the entries as `...` to stay short.

```json
{
  "title": "Today (2026-11-15)",
  "start": "2026-11-14T22:00:00.000Z",
  "end": "2026-11-15T14:04:47.282Z",
  "isMultiDay": false,
  "done": [
    {
      "project": "billing-api",
      "entries": [
        "..."
      ]
    }
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "..."
  ],
  "next": [
    "..."
  ],
  "stale": {
    "count": 0,
    "ids": [],
    "days": 14
  },
  "linkedActivity": {},
  "also": null,
  "syncWarning": null
}
```
